sections.heading: One Box System Across Every Device Size
sections.text: Tech Accessory Retail One Box System Across Every Device Size Phone case brands juggle dozens of device SKUs. Our system fixes the outer box and window, and swaps only the inner tray per device — so iPhone, Samsung and Pixel variants share tooling, shelf footprint and shipping cartons while every case sits perfectly centred. The PET window is optically flat (no funhouse warp over the case pattern); the tray tilts the case 8° toward the glass so the camera-cutout story reads on shelf. A satin ribbon pull lifts the case out without fingernail-scratching the tray. Soft-touch lamination with spot UV is the category-standard finish. Peg version available with reinforced tabs ( hang tab boxes ); e-commerce runs pair with tear-strip mailers .

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions How do you handle many device sizes? One shared outer box and window; only the inner tray changes per device. New launches need a tray die only — tooling, shelf footprint and shipping cartons stay stable. Will the window scratch or warp? We use optically flat PET with an anti-scratch coating, so clear and patterned cases read true on shelf. Can the same design hang on pegs? Yes — a reinforced hang-tab edition of the same design serves peg walls; see our hang tab boxes for slot options. What finish is standard for the category? Soft-touch lamination with spot UV logo; holographic and foil variants are stocked for youth lines. What is the MOQ? 200 pcs per tray SKU, samples in 3–5 business days.
